subject: mass-communication
title: New Media: Target Audience
meta: Lesson practice set · Question types of the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: Practice set for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

questions.q: Which factor makes news more appealing to youth in new media?
Exposure to too much information is called —
Difficulty in using information leading to depression is —
Which writing style is used in new journalism to attract and engage young audiences?
______ websites cater specialized content like lifestyle and health.
New journalism was pioneered by —
The father of creativity (lateral thinking) is —
SME stands for —
Which is a side effect of new media for youth?
The stories for new media are broken up into several stories with ______ to form a package.

sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks: The stories for new media are broken up into several ______ with ______ to form a package.

Match: (i) Exposure to too much information (ii) Difficulty in using information (iii) New journalism (iv) Father of creativity with (a) Tom Wolfe (b) information overload (c) information fatigue (d) Edward de Bono.
State true or false: (i) We develop interpersonal skills when we deal with people. (ii) Children today are generally found to be socially active.
Fill in the blanks: ______ and ______ are side effects of new media for youth.
questions.answer: Information fatigue; time consumption (or trolling and cyberbullying).

questions.q: Write the full form of SME and name any one niche website topic.
questions.answer: Small and Medium Enterprises; travel (also housing, health, sports).

sections.title: Very short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: What is meant by information overload?
questions.answer: Exposure to too much information which leaves a person confused and unable to use it.

questions.q: List any three creative factors of new media that engage youth.
questions.answer: Narrative story telling, stories broken into short segments with multimedia, attractive visuals and short crisp main story, lateral thinking, human interest.

questions.q: What are niche websites?
questions.answer: Websites that contain very specialised content such as travel, health or sports.

questions.q: What is a revenue model in new media?
questions.answer: The way a venture earns income, e.g. advertising, content selling, subscriptions and specialised services.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Explain the impact of new media on youth.
questions.answer: It informs the youth and attracts them with creative narrative stories, but causes information overload and fatigue, reduces outdoor play and interpersonal skills and confidence.

questions.q: Explain how new media is beneficial for youth with relevant examples.
questions.answer: It gives quick information, online libraries and e-learning, a place to write blogs and chat with friends, online shopping and games and business opportunities.

questions.q: Discuss the impact of new media on interpersonal relations.
questions.answer: Youth chat online without meeting, so talking, listening and sharing skills and confidence suffer; balance and regulation of internet use are needed.

questions.q: Is new media a big industry or an SME? Give reasons.
questions.answer: It is an SME as it needs little infrastructure and money but much creativity; niche websites started in small rooms and grew.

sections.title: Long answer question. Answer in 80–120 words.

questions.q: Discuss the youth as the target audience of new media, with the creativity factor and problems.
questions.answer: The youth spend more time with computers and want information, but face information overload and fatigue; new media attracts them with narrative style, short crisp stories and multimedia, while interpersonal relations suffer.

questions.q: Explain the business opportunities of new media.
questions.answer: New media ventures are SMEs needing creativity, e.g. niche websites, e-learning, tourism and online shopping, earning through advertising, subscriptions, content selling and services.
